title: Pan-Seared Trout Relleno
description: A flavorful dish that combines the delicate taste of trout with the richness of a Mexican relleno.

ingredients.name: mexican spices
ingredients.notes: such as cumin and chili powder

instructions: 1. Preheat a skillet over medium heat.
2. Season the trout fillets with salt and pepper.
3. Add a tablespoon of oil to the skillet and sear the trout for 2-3 minutes on each side.
4. Meanwhile, stuff each trout fillet with a spoonful of relleno filling.
5. Add the stuffed trout to the skillet and cook for an additional 3-4 minutes.
6. Top each trout fillet with a slice of chile and a sprinkle of cheese.
7. Transfer the trout to a plate and serve immediately.
8. Garnish with fresh cilantro and a dollop of sour cream, if desired.
9. Serve with a side of Mexican rice and beans.
